'''Hermos''' was an astronomical object<ref name="GH" /> located in the [[Hermos system/Legends|Hermos system]], a part of the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had at least one [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Yesgar's pirates|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Yesgar]], who had a hideout on<ref name="GH" /> the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="EAOC Antared">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Antared system/Legends|Antared system]]</ref> celestial body [[Antared III]], were spotted in Hermos's spaceport.<ref name="GH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hermos was introduced in ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the game, the celestial body was mentioned in a hypothetical example in a section advising gamemaster players on the use of various paper handouts in their games.<ref name="GH" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Hermos [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square R-5. The book's co-author<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jason Fry]] has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star/Legends|star]] systems listed in the Appendix section of ''The Essential Atlas'' are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of Hermos to be [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref>
